definitions.explanation: Letters, packages, and other items sent through the postal system. The standard term for physical mail.

examples.japanese: {郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}が{届|とど}いた。
{不在|ふざい}で{郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}を{受|う}け{取|と}れなかった。
examples.english: I was out and couldn't receive the mail.

examples.japanese: {大量|たいりょう}の{郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}が{毎日|まいにち}{届|とど}くので、{仕分|しわ}けが{大変|たいへん}だ。
examples.english: A large volume of mail arrives every day, so sorting it is quite a task.

notes:
The standard term for physical mail of all types — letters, packages, postcards, etc. More formal and comprehensive than {手紙|てがみ} (letter) or {荷物|にもつ} (package).

WORD FORMATION:
{郵便|ゆうびん} (postal service) + {物|ぶつ} (item, thing)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}が{届|とど}く: mail arrives
- {郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}を{届|とど}ける: to deliver mail
- {郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}の{転送|てんそう}: mail forwarding
- {書留|かきとめ}{郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}: registered mail
- {郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}を{受|う}け{取|と}る: to receive mail

RELATED:
- {郵便|ゆうびん}{受|う}け/{郵便|ゆうびん}ポスト: mailbox
- {宅配便|たくはいびん}: home delivery service (courier)
- {小包|こづつみ}: parcel, small package
